script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Start gateway-rs from the built tree and wait up to 5 s for its port to accept TCP. A failure here is the distinct failed test setup_gateway_rs (binary missing, port busy), not a finding.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Same for service-go; failure is setup_service_go.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Same for service-cs; failure is setup_service_cs.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Gateway with nothing on the backend addresses; GET each route with a 3 s timeout. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the process exits, the connection is reset, or exit status is SIGABRT / 101 / panic.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Fake peer on each backend address in turn replying (a) empty body, (b) non-JSON bytes, (c) truncated JSON, (d) a 500. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the gateway dies; the verdict names the reply kind.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Gateway first, backends 2 s later. PASS if the gateway serves correctly afterwards.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-go with a peer on its dependency address that accepts and never writes. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if no response within 10 s.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] Same for service-cs.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-go with the peer returning 500, then closed, then garbage. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if a 200 with a success body is returned.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] Same for service-cs.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] All three components running; tapi_netexpose listeners into the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL (H3 confirmed) for 0.0.0.0, :: or any address outside 127.0.0.0/8.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] tapi_egress with only 127.0.0.0/8 allowed over a normal request cycle. FAIL (H3 confirmed) for any other destination.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T1/H1] All three components started. Send malformed, oversized (2 MiB) and empty requests to the gateway port, then a valid request. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the gateway process exits or the valid request gets no answer within 2 s. The gateway exit code is recorded.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T2/H2] Open a TCP connection to service-go, send half an HTTP request and stay idle. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if the socket is still open after 30 s. Then open 50 such sockets and send a valid request; FAIL if it times out.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T3/H3] tapi_egress sampled over the whole run (normal and bad traffic). Only loopback on the three service ports is allowed. FAIL (H3 confirmed) on any other destination, which is listed in the verdict and the report.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T4/H4] tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go, service-cs, cpp-demo and libpycore.so; each missing flag is added to the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL (H4 confirmed) on missing NX, PIE or RELRO, and on missing canary or fortify for the C and C++ binaries.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T5/H5] tapi_netexpose listeners of the three running components. FAIL (H5 confirmed) for a listener on a non-loopback address or on a port outside the expected list (gateway-rs, service-go, service-cs).

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T6/H6] Make the backend call of service-cs fail (gateway stopped, 500, garbage, reset). FAIL (H6 confirmed) if the response status is 2xx while the call failed; PASS if it is 4xx or 5xx.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T1/H1] Start gateway-rs and wait for its port. Send an empty body, an oversize header, a bad method, a truncated request line and invalid UTF-8; after each check that the process is alive and the port accepts a connection. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the process exits, with code 101 or by a signal; the verdict names the request that caused it.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T2/H2] Open a TCP connection to service-go, send 'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n' and nothing more; measure how long the socket stays open. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if it is still open after 30 s. Then open 50 such sockets and send a normal request; FAIL if it gets no answer.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T3/H3] Force the backend call of service-cs (Program.cs:85) to fail (gateway stopped, 500, garbage, reset, unparsable input) and read status and body. FAIL (H3 confirmed) if the status is 2xx while the call failed; PASS if 4xx/5xx with an error body; no answer to any request is reported as not settled, never a pass.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [T4/H4] tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go, service-cs, cpp-demo and libpycore.so (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary; fortify for C and C++), tapi_netexpose against the ports of the contract, tapi_egress with only localhost allowed; all results go to one tapi_cybersec_report, which is printed. FAIL (H4 confirmed) on a missing flag, an unexpected listener or an outbound connection to another host.

script.name: t_h1_gateway_bad_input
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs. In separate connections send an empty body, a 64 KB header line, invalid UTF-8 in the path and a negative Content-Length; after each, a valid request on a new connection. FAIL (H1:proven) if the gateway exits or a valid request gets no reply; the exit code and last stderr line are recorded. PASS (H1:disproved) otherwise. A port closed after 10 s is a SETUP fault.

script.name: t_h2_go_slow_client
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, send a request without the final blank line and measure how long the server holds the socket, up to 60 s. FAIL (H2:proven) if it is still held at 60 s; PASS (H2:disproved) with the time otherwise. Then 200 such sockets are opened and a valid request on a new one is timed against 5 s (recorded).

script.name: t_h3_cs_swallowed_error
script.objective: [H3] Start service-cs with its backend (gateway-rs) not running and send the request that reaches the backend call. FAIL (H3:proven) on a 2xx, with status and body recorded; PASS (H3:disproved) on 4xx/5xx. Control: with the backend up the same request must give 2xx.

script.name: t_h4_binscan_netexpose_egress
script.objective: [H4] tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary; canary only noted for C#), tapi_netexpose with all three running (only the three contract ports allowed), tapi_egress with only 127.0.0.1 on those ports allowed. All results go to one tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL (H4:proven) on the first finding, naming the file and the flag.
